context: Basic five: Frowning Gaper10.0, Gaper10.1, Gusher11.0, Pacer11.1, Horf12.0. All remain in_progress. Ordinary Sub Horf812.0is now implemented with scoped tests; it remains in_progress.

gaps.details: The generic combat handlers exist from the five-Charger batch. Applying all of them to the basic five is still blocked by eligibility guards and lacks family-specific validation. Gusher additionally allows Magenta. Reuse existing handlers; do not describe this as18totally unwritten champion engines. Sub Horf now allows all26combat types with per-body scoped tests; its shared special loot/rarity gaps remain separate.
examples: Dark Red revival must coexist correctly with Gaper headless morph and room-clear accounting.
Pulsing Green split children and Light White fly births need correct body identity, affiliation and bounded admission.
White must release invulnerability without a softlock; Skull linked deaths must not duplicate rewards.

gaps.area: Champion-specific resource rewards and selection weights
gaps.details: Current ordinary DeathWard loot is used. Isaac-specific champion hearts, batteries, pills and other reward mappings are not implemented. Champion type selection is uniform over eligible types rather than native rarity weights. A DeathWard resource adaptation must be explicitly chosen and documented.

Fear/confusion/freeze/slow/poison/burn/shrink/charm have enemy-side runtime handlers and scoped tests. Production applyEnemyStatus calls currently come from the CLI/debug driver; item dispatch in src/items/Items.cpp has split/powder/ghost/cap hooks and does not apply these statuses. A tested effect API does not mean a pickup grants that effect.
examples: A poison-shot item must apply the configured poison on an actual admitted enemy hit.
A freeze/charm item needs its trigger, proc chance, duration, ownership, immunity and expiration wired end to end.

gaps.area: Actual build combinations and lifecycle integration
gaps.details: Existing weapon items are implemented. Complete per-enemy acceptance has not covered every relevant combination of ricochet, split, piercing, homing, returning bullets, blast/kill chains and statuses across morph, death, room/floor transitions and save/load. Determine the applicable matrix first; there is no audited finite remaining count for all items.
examples: A split or returning projectile must not duplicate status application or a kill reward.
A charmed champion’s bullets, creep and children need consistent ownership after death or a room change.
Gaper-to-headless morph must preserve/clear each modifier according to an explicit source rule.

gaps.details: Green/Brown-style trails on stationary bodies need a source-specific review rather than assuming the moving-Charger behavior is correct for Horf. Current Green handler places creep periodically even without movement.

remaining: Isaac-specific champion pickup rewards and native rarity weighting remain unimplemented/adapted in the shared system.
Isaac-specific champion pickup rewards and native rarity weighting remain unimplemented/adapted in the shared system.
Real item pickups do not yet call the status-application API. Poison/freeze/charm item activation and proc rules remain missing.
Full Sub Horf×weapon/status/champion/morph/room/save interaction matrix is not complete; the current tests cover selected combinations only.
Exact native final-death projectile packet/direction, special knockback sources, Dross water streams and source-specific status/item exceptions remain unverified.
Mixed-room/occlusion visual acceptance, human balance and dense rendered performance remain open.
Tainted Sub Horf812.1remains a separate missing actor.
combined_checked: Freeze+Slow: spin and firing pause; controller resumes after thaw.
Permanent Charm: death shot keeps NPC targeting/player immunity after corpse cleanup; no hostile kill payout.
Enemy-owned Poison+Freeze+permanent Charm: damage continues, final shot retains affiliation. Player/ally-origin damage is separately blocked by the existing permanent-Charm policy.
Death shot+full projectile capacity: retry retains source, ownership and one-shot count; room completes after its projectile resolves.
Existing first-floor Charm suite: Fear target selection, Confusion suppression, Slow shot ownership, frozen/swept contacts, morph/room/follower lifecycle,40basic champion combinations and recoil.

Existing weapon-build suite:66unordered pairs including duplicates, both acquisition orders and mouse/arrow controls; chain bounds, provenance, room cleanup, dynamite and save round trips. These are synthetic target tests, not a complete Sub Horf/build matrix.
Native render check: Freeze+Poison+temporary Charm coexist; the body preserves status tint and the visible Charm cue. The base SubHorf color is applied before shared status tinting.
Sub Horf all26combat types:52stat/Charm and52death-affiliation scenarios; revival, split offspring, nine-shot death volleys and seeded resident preparation. See sub-horf/champions/status.json.
